mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements: 1. Under the Bretton Woods system, currencies were pegged to the dollar and the dollar was pegged to gold. 2. The Smithsonian Agreement of 1971 widened the exchange-rate band to 2.25%. 3. The Smithsonian Agreement lasted about 14 years. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: Smithsonian band was widened from 1% to 2.25%, not 2.5%
